answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 47539 Country: India Title: What is the fidhya of roza Question: I would like to know the fidyah of fast because he is really old and about to die. So I want to know the fidyah of fast. Answer ID: 47539 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1315/906/L=11/1434) The fidyah of one fast is half saa’ (1574.640 gram) wheat or its price. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
